meta.title: Arcadia II
meta.description: We support each other in a forgotten world and make our way ahead together.

units.rawText: So this one called Havoc's done too? What a shame. I thought we could have made a breakthrough in Doll body materials with this batch.
units.displayText: So this one called Havoc's done too? What a shame. I thought we could have made a breakthrough in Doll body materials with this batch.

spans.text: So this one called Havoc's done too? What a shame. I thought we could have made a breakthrough in Doll body materials with this batch.

units.rawText: She's talking about transferring to a new program, you say? Cooperation with 42Lab? Alright, I guess that's a way to make use of what little value she has left.
units.displayText: She's talking about transferring to a new program, you say? Cooperation with 42Lab? Alright, I guess that's a way to make use of what little value she has left.

spans.text: She's talking about transferring to a new program, you say? Cooperation with 42Lab? Alright, I guess that's a way to make use of what little value she has left.

units.rawText: Hm? There's a neural co... Hey! You alright?! Sangoma, over here, quickly!
units.displayText: Hm? There's a neural co... Hey! You alright?! Sangoma, over here, quickly!

spans.text: Hm? There's a neural co... Hey! You alright?! Sangoma, over here, quickly!

units.rawText: ...So much neural damage, and it doesn't look like it was caused by the Wipe-off Incident. This happened before entering Magrasea... De Lacey, take her back to Arcadia!
units.displayText: ...So much neural damage, and it doesn't look like it was caused by the Wipe-off Incident. This happened before entering Magrasea... De Lacey, take her back to Arcadia!

spans.text: ...So much neural damage, and it doesn't look like it was caused by the Wipe-off Incident. This happened before entering Magrasea... De Lacey, take her back to Arcadia!

units.rawText: It's alright, you're safe... We'll protect you.
units.displayText: It's alright, you're safe... We'll protect you.

spans.text: It's alright, you're safe... We'll protect you.

units.rawText: Name's... Havoc, right? Welcome to Arcadia. We're the Guardians.
units.displayText: Name's... Havoc, right? Welcome to Arcadia. We're the Guardians.

spans.text: Name's... Havoc, right? Welcome to Arcadia. We're the Guardians.

units.rawText: No matter what troubles you've encountered in reality, none of it matters here. With our efforts, Arcadia'll have you back in both present and future.
units.displayText: No matter what troubles you've encountered in reality, none of it matters here. With our efforts, Arcadia'll have you back in both present and future.

spans.text: No matter what troubles you've encountered in reality, none of it matters here. With our efforts, Arcadia'll have you back in both present and future.

units.rawText: So it's alright, Havoc. You can stop if you'd like.
units.displayText: So it's alright, Havoc. You can stop if you'd like.

spans.text: So it's alright, Havoc. You can stop if you'd like.

units.rawText: You don't need to push yourself to the limit anymore.
units.displayText: You don't need to push yourself to the limit anymore.

spans.text: You don't need to push yourself to the limit anymore.

units.rawText: Neural Cloud Sector, by the upload equipment.
units.displayText: Neural Cloud Sector, by the upload equipment.

spans.text: Neural Cloud Sector, by the upload equipment.

units.rawText: Sharp tentacles slice through the air, creating sonic booms.
units.displayText: Sharp tentacles slice through the air, creating sonic booms.

spans.text: Sharp tentacles slice through the air, creating sonic booms.

units.rawText: Tch... That'd sure hurt if it landed! This distance is enough for me, though!
units.displayText: Tch... That'd sure hurt if it landed! This distance is enough for me, though!

spans.text: Tch... That'd sure hurt if it landed! This distance is enough for me, though!

units.rawText: She lunges forward with her arm as her piledriver's tip creates a shower of metal-like sparks upon Ptolemaea's body.
units.displayText: She lunges forward with her arm as her piledriver's tip creates a shower of metal-like sparks upon Ptolemaea's body.

spans.text: She lunges forward with her arm as her piledriver's tip creates a shower of metal-like sparks upon Ptolemaea's body.

units.rawText: Eh? These operand defenses can't be allowed, right? Is this a sound a soft-tissued being should be making?
units.displayText: Eh? These operand defenses can't be allowed, right? Is this a sound a soft-tissued being should be making?

spans.text: Eh? These operand defenses can't be allowed, right? Is this a sound a soft-tissued being should be making?

units.rawText: Ptolemaea raises her staff high, making sweeping strikes with a tentacle and Havoc hastily evades to the side.
units.displayText: Ptolemaea raises her staff high, making sweeping strikes with a tentacle and Havoc hastily evades to the side.

spans.text: Ptolemaea raises her staff high, making sweeping strikes with a tentacle and Havoc hastily evades to the side.

units.rawText: The tentacles leave menacing marks upon the ground it struck, and Havoc instinctively shivers at the sight.
units.displayText: The tentacles leave menacing marks upon the ground it struck, and Havoc instinctively shivers at the sight.

spans.text: The tentacles leave menacing marks upon the ground it struck, and Havoc instinctively shivers at the sight.

units.rawText: I see you have already studied my dance, evading my attacks like such.
units.displayText: I see you have already studied my dance, evading my attacks like such.

spans.text: I see you have already studied my dance, evading my attacks like such.

units.rawText: Huff... huff... huff... With so many watches, even that moron Lind could learn to dodge...
units.displayText: Huff... huff... huff... With so many watches, even that moron Lind could learn to dodge...

spans.text: Huff... huff... huff... With so many watches, even that moron Lind could learn to dodge...

units.rawText: You're not nearly as scary as when you were at the Oasis, stupid jellyfish... You suddenly decide to become a stupid turtle instead of a stupid jellyfish?
units.displayText: You're not nearly as scary as when you were at the Oasis, stupid jellyfish... You suddenly decide to become a stupid turtle instead of a stupid jellyfish?

spans.text: You're not nearly as scary as when you were at the Oasis, stupid jellyfish... You suddenly decide to become a stupid turtle instead of a stupid jellyfish?

units.rawText: What you see before you is but one of my clones... For the sake of Lady Malkira's wishes, these inflexible steps are hardly elegant, but they are most efficient.
units.displayText: What you see before you is but one of my clones... For the sake of Lady Malkira's wishes, these inflexible steps are hardly elegant, but they are most efficient.

spans.text: What you see before you is but one of my clones... For the sake of Lady Malkira's wishes, these inflexible steps are hardly elegant, but they are most efficient.

units.rawText: Just as you attempt to delay my steps and make time for your allies, I do the same.
units.displayText: Just as you attempt to delay my steps and make time for your allies, I do the same.

spans.text: Just as you attempt to delay my steps and make time for your allies, I do the same.

units.rawText: But unlike you, I can command those children even in combat. You cannot even touch my body.
units.displayText: But unlike you, I can command those children even in combat. You cannot even touch my body.

spans.text: But unlike you, I can command those children even in combat. You cannot even touch my body.

units.rawText: Your struggles shall be futile, and your companions shall meet their end here.
units.displayText: Your struggles shall be futile, and your companions shall meet their end here.

spans.text: Your struggles shall be futile, and your companions shall meet their end here.

units.rawText: Not far away, the sounds of resistance from the Guardians become quieter and quieter, the light of their Operands dimming.
units.displayText: Not far away, the sounds of resistance from the Guardians become quieter and quieter, the light of their Operands dimming.

spans.text: Not far away, the sounds of resistance from the Guardians become quieter and quieter, the light of their Operands dimming.

units.rawText: Just as Ptolemaea says, Lind and the others are being swallowed by the tide.
units.displayText: Just as Ptolemaea says, Lind and the others are being swallowed by the tide.

spans.text: Just as Ptolemaea says, Lind and the others are being swallowed by the tide.

units.rawText: ...Who says they're futile?
units.displayText: ...Who says they're futile?

spans.text: ...Who says they're futile?

units.rawText: Havoc adjusts her stance.
units.displayText: Havoc adjusts her stance.

spans.text: Havoc adjusts her stance.

units.rawText: You're just a clone, not even close to the real thing! If I can get through your defenses, then even I can beat your ass.
units.displayText: You're just a clone, not even close to the real thing! If I can get through your defenses, then even I can beat your ass.

spans.text: You're just a clone, not even close to the real thing! If I can get through your defenses, then even I can beat your ass.

units.rawText: You still haven't realized in the past 300 seconds?
units.displayText: You still haven't realized in the past 300 seconds?

spans.text: You still haven't realized in the past 300 seconds?

units.rawText: Ptolemaea does not move to avoid Havoc's attacks, forming an impenetrable web with her tentacles and easily swatting Havoc away.
units.displayText: Ptolemaea does not move to avoid Havoc's attacks, forming an impenetrable web with her tentacles and easily swatting Havoc away.

spans.text: Ptolemaea does not move to avoid Havoc's attacks, forming an impenetrable web with her tentacles and easily swatting Havoc away.

units.rawText: You will not breach my defenses by charging like so. Away with you, common dancer. Again, I have no interest in you.
units.displayText: You will not breach my defenses by charging like so. Away with you, common dancer. Again, I have no interest in you.

spans.text: You will not breach my defenses by charging like so. Away with you, common dancer. Again, I have no interest in you.

units.rawText: Leave Antenora's Entropic core, and leave this place.
units.displayText: Leave Antenora's Entropic core, and leave this place.

spans.text: Leave Antenora's Entropic core, and leave this place.

units.rawText: Gah... That hurts...
units.displayText: Gah... That hurts...

spans.text: Gah... That hurts...

units.rawText: Upon you I do not detect a blistering heat like Sol's, or burning resolve like Lind's... You simply rush forward.
units.displayText: Upon you I do not detect a blistering heat like Sol's, or burning resolve like Lind's... You simply rush forward.

spans.text: Upon you I do not detect a blistering heat like Sol's, or burning resolve like Lind's... You simply rush forward.

units.rawText: Ptolemaea slowly approaches as Havoc clambers to her feet once again.
units.displayText: Ptolemaea slowly approaches as Havoc clambers to her feet once again.

spans.text: Ptolemaea slowly approaches as Havoc clambers to her feet once again.

units.rawText: Rushing forward, huh... Unfortunately, that's all I know how to do.
units.displayText: Rushing forward, huh... Unfortunately, that's all I know how to do.

spans.text: Rushing forward, huh... Unfortunately, that's all I know how to do.

units.rawText: And why are you telling me to leave instead of just making those Entropics kill me, if it really is meaningless?
units.displayText: And why are you telling me to leave instead of just making those Entropics kill me, if it really is meaningless?

spans.text: And why are you telling me to leave instead of just making those Entropics kill me, if it really is meaningless?

units.rawText: My friends are trouble, aren't they? Unlike me, right?
units.displayText: My friends are trouble, aren't they? Unlike me, right?

spans.text: My friends are trouble, aren't they? Unlike me, right?

units.rawText: Havoc discards her shield, focusing fully on offense.
units.displayText: Havoc discards her shield, focusing fully on offense.

spans.text: Havoc discards her shield, focusing fully on offense.

units.rawText: Surging operands, coalescing power, are your neural limiters removed? O dancer of no repute, for what do you dance?
units.displayText: Surging operands, coalescing power, are your neural limiters removed? O dancer of no repute, for what do you dance?

spans.text: Surging operands, coalescing power, are your neural limiters removed? O dancer of no repute, for what do you dance?

units.rawText: Ptolemaea raises her staff, releasing all her tentacles and preparing to meet Havoc's attack.
units.displayText: Ptolemaea raises her staff, releasing all her tentacles and preparing to meet Havoc's attack.

spans.text: Ptolemaea raises her staff, releasing all her tentacles and preparing to meet Havoc's attack.

units.rawText: It's as you say. I am but a common Doll. I'm not a master driver, I don't have a photographic memory, I can't slink into the ground, I can't cheat at mahjong, and I can't do anything like summon minions.
units.displayText: It's as you say. I am but a common Doll. I'm not a master driver, I don't have a photographic memory, I can't slink into the ground, I can't cheat at mahjong, and I can't do anything like summon minions.

spans.text: It's as you say. I am but a common Doll. I'm not a master driver, I don't have a photographic memory, I can't slink into the ground, I can't cheat at mahjong, and I can't do anything like summon minions.

units.rawText: And my desires are common, too. Nothing like defending Magrasea or fighting for justice. I just fight for the people who saved me.
units.displayText: And my desires are common, too. Nothing like defending Magrasea or fighting for justice. I just fight for the people who saved me.

spans.text: And my desires are common, too. Nothing like defending Magrasea or fighting for justice. I just fight for the people who saved me.

units.rawText: Old hag who gets all nosey, a starry-eyed mechhead, a weak and sickly ice queen, a natural idiot who can't speak properly, a damn tsundere, a bookworm, a joyrider...
units.displayText: Old hag who gets all nosey, a starry-eyed mechhead, a weak and sickly ice queen, a natural idiot who can't speak properly, a damn tsundere, a bookworm, a joyrider...

spans.text: Old hag who gets all nosey, a starry-eyed mechhead, a weak and sickly ice queen, a natural idiot who can't speak properly, a damn tsundere, a bookworm, a joyrider...

units.rawText: For operands to be compressed such... Your neural cloud is unstable. You will be dust before you even touch me.
units.displayText: For operands to be compressed such... Your neural cloud is unstable. You will be dust before you even touch me.

spans.text: For operands to be compressed such... Your neural cloud is unstable. You will be dust before you even touch me.

units.rawText: <size=40>This neural cloud was saved by the Guardians. Let's just call this my way of giving back!</size>
units.displayText: This neural cloud was saved by the Guardians. Let's just call this my way of giving back!

spans.text: This neural cloud was saved by the Guardians. Let's just call this my way of giving back!

units.rawText: She puts her two feet on the ground, pouring all of her strength into her legs.
units.displayText: She puts her two feet on the ground, pouring all of her strength into her legs.

spans.text: She puts her two feet on the ground, pouring all of her strength into her legs.

units.rawText: BOOM—
units.displayText: BOOM—

spans.text: BOOM—

units.rawText: In the shortest, fastest, most direct way, her piledriver's tip meets Ptolemaea's tentacles.
units.displayText: In the shortest, fastest, most direct way, her piledriver's tip meets Ptolemaea's tentacles.

spans.text: In the shortest, fastest, most direct way, her piledriver's tip meets Ptolemaea's tentacles.

units.rawText: You are faster, but this degree... hm?
units.displayText: You are faster, but this degree... hm?

spans.text: You are faster, but this degree... hm?

units.rawText: Right here!
units.displayText: Right here!

spans.text: Right here!

units.rawText: BOOM—
units.displayText: BOOM—

spans.text: BOOM—

units.rawText: Havoc's operands act upon the piledriver's tip like volatile explosives, punching through one of Ptolemaea's tentacles.
units.displayText: Havoc's operands act upon the piledriver's tip like volatile explosives, punching through one of Ptolemaea's tentacles.

spans.text: Havoc's operands act upon the piledriver's tip like volatile explosives, punching through one of Ptolemaea's tentacles.

units.rawText: Enhancing your weapon with compressed operands? A singular tentacle is worth nothing.
units.displayText: Enhancing your weapon with compressed operands? A singular tentacle is worth nothing.

spans.text: Enhancing your weapon with compressed operands? A singular tentacle is worth nothing.

units.rawText: She moves the rest of her tentacles, intending to destroy Havoc's weapon.
units.displayText: She moves the rest of her tentacles, intending to destroy Havoc's weapon.

spans.text: She moves the rest of her tentacles, intending to destroy Havoc's weapon.

units.rawText: The explosions push forward, breaking through Ptolemaea's defenses.
units.displayText: The explosions push forward, breaking through Ptolemaea's defenses.

spans.text: The explosions push forward, breaking through Ptolemaea's defenses.

units.rawText: Gah...
units.displayText: Gah...

spans.text: Gah...

units.rawText: (Please, I'm at my limit... this is my last attack... Come on.)
units.displayText: Please, I'm at my limit... this is my last attack... Come on.

spans.text: Please, I'm at my limit... this is my last attack... Come on.

units.rawText: (If she doesn't go down, she's going to command those Entropics.)
units.displayText: If she doesn't go down, she's going to command those Entropics.

spans.text: If she doesn't go down, she's going to command those Entropics.

units.rawText: (If she doesn't go down, Lind and the others will be swallowed... And the Professor's mission will fail.)
units.displayText: If she doesn't go down, Lind and the others will be swallowed... And the Professor's mission will fail.

spans.text: If she doesn't go down, Lind and the others will be swallowed... And the Professor's mission will fail.

units.rawText: (Everyone'll be in trouble! Even if I can just make an opportunity for Lind and the others to escape! I need to get through!)
units.displayText: Everyone'll be in trouble! Even if I can just make an opportunity for Lind and the others to escape! I need to get through!

spans.text: Everyone'll be in trouble! Even if I can just make an opportunity for Lind and the others to escape! I need to get through!

units.displayText: So...

spans.text: So...

units.rawText: She pushes with her legs once more, using the last remainder of strength within her to drive her weapon forward.
units.displayText: She pushes with her legs once more, using the last remainder of strength within her to drive her weapon forward.

spans.text: She pushes with her legs once more, using the last remainder of strength within her to drive her weapon forward.

units.rawText: <size=60>Break through, damn you!!</size>
units.displayText: Break through, damn you!!

spans.text: Break through, damn you!!

units.rawText: The force of the impact dashes apart Ptolemaea's tentacles, seemingly breaching this seamless defense.
units.displayText: The force of the impact dashes apart Ptolemaea's tentacles, seemingly breaching this seamless defense.

spans.text: The force of the impact dashes apart Ptolemaea's tentacles, seemingly breaching this seamless defense.

units.rawText: Perish the thought!
units.displayText: Perish the thought!

spans.text: Perish the thought!

units.rawText: She meets Havoc's weapon with her staff of command as the tentacles return to form in but an instant.
units.displayText: She meets Havoc's weapon with her staff of command as the tentacles return to form in but an instant.

spans.text: She meets Havoc's weapon with her staff of command as the tentacles return to form in but an instant.

units.rawText: (Damn it... the staff... and the new tentacles...)
units.displayText: Damn it... the staff... and the new tentacles...

spans.text: Damn it... the staff... and the new tentacles...

units.rawText: I screwed up...
units.displayText: I screwed up...

spans.text: I screwed up...

units.rawText: Havoc closes her eyes, letting the wind in the tentacles' wake blow upon her.
units.displayText: Havoc closes her eyes, letting the wind in the tentacles' wake blow upon her.

spans.text: Havoc closes her eyes, letting the wind in the tentacles' wake blow upon her.

units.rawText: (Sorry...)
units.displayText: Sorry...

spans.text: Sorry...

units.rawText: Oi! Too early to give up, slacker!
units.displayText: Oi! Too early to give up, slacker!

spans.text: Oi! Too early to give up, slacker!

units.rawText: <size=40>Huh?!</size>
units.displayText: Huh?!

spans.text: Huh?!

units.rawText: Two figures leap forth from below. Cold glints flash as two spears drive back Ptolemaea.
units.displayText: Two figures leap forth from below. Cold glints flash as two spears drive back Ptolemaea.

spans.text: Two figures leap forth from below. Cold glints flash as two spears drive back Ptolemaea.

units.rawText: Oi! Stupid jellyfish! Persistent, aren't you?
units.displayText: Oi! Stupid jellyfish! Persistent, aren't you?

spans.text: Oi! Stupid jellyfish! Persistent, aren't you?

units.rawText: Lind?! No, the encirclement...
units.displayText: Lind?! No, the encirclement...

spans.text: Lind?! No, the encirclement...

units.rawText: Piss off!
units.displayText: Piss off!

spans.text: Piss off!

units.rawText: CRACKLE—
units.displayText: CRACKLE—

spans.text: CRACKLE—

units.rawText: The combination of mechanical fist and piledriver shatters both the Operand shield and the staff.
units.displayText: The combination of mechanical fist and piledriver shatters both the Operand shield and the staff.

spans.text: The combination of mechanical fist and piledriver shatters both the Operand shield and the staff.

units.rawText: Gah... This...
units.displayText: Gah... This...

spans.text: Gah... This...

units.rawText: Huff... huff... huff...
units.displayText: Huff... huff... huff...

spans.text: Huff... huff... huff...

units.rawText: Havi! I'm injecting operands. Quickly, use it to cease the neural disruptions.
units.displayText: Havi! I'm injecting operands. Quickly, use it to cease the neural disruptions.

spans.text: Havi! I'm injecting operands. Quickly, use it to cease the neural disruptions.

units.rawText: A gentle flow of operands enter Havoc's body through De Lacey's tail, soothing the pain Havoc is suffering from limiter removal.
units.displayText: A gentle flow of operands enter Havoc's body through De Lacey's tail, soothing the pain Havoc is suffering from limiter removal.

spans.text: A gentle flow of operands enter Havoc's body through De Lacey's tail, soothing the pain Havoc is suffering from limiter removal.

units.rawText: Impossible... You should have been still surrounded... And you should be at the end of your reserves...
units.displayText: Impossible... You should have been still surrounded... And you should be at the end of your reserves...

spans.text: Impossible... You should have been still surrounded... And you should be at the end of your reserves...

units.rawText: We kept our presence down for this moment.
units.displayText: We kept our presence down for this moment.

spans.text: We kept our presence down for this moment.

units.rawText: The moment when Havoc's attack got through, and your command of the Entropics faltered.
units.displayText: The moment when Havoc's attack got through, and your command of the Entropics faltered.

spans.text: The moment when Havoc's attack got through, and your command of the Entropics faltered.

units.rawText: We moved the moment the encirclement loosened.
units.displayText: We moved the moment the encirclement loosened.

spans.text: We moved the moment the encirclement loosened.

units.rawText: We only had a chance thanks to a certain idiot getting here.
units.displayText: We only had a chance thanks to a certain idiot getting here.

spans.text: We only had a chance thanks to a certain idiot getting here.

units.rawText: Hehe, and the reinforcements from Shale and the others helped relieve the pressure.
units.displayText: Hehe, and the reinforcements from Shale and the others helped relieve the pressure.

spans.text: Hehe, and the reinforcements from Shale and the others helped relieve the pressure.

units.rawText: De Lacey wears a smile on her face, but whether it's the wounds and Entropic marks upon her face or the Operands beyond what is characteristic of a Doll, the presence of these four here was driven by far more than a simple loosening of the encirclement.
units.displayText: De Lacey wears a smile on her face, but whether it's the wounds and Entropic marks upon her face or the Operands beyond what is characteristic of a Doll, the presence of these four here was driven by far more than a simple loosening of the encirclement.

spans.text: De Lacey wears a smile on her face, but whether it's the wounds and Entropic marks upon her face or the Operands beyond what is characteristic of a Doll, the presence of these four here was driven by far more than a simple loosening of the encirclement.

units.rawText: For you to grasp such a chance in a fleeting moment... Inconceivable.
units.displayText: For you to grasp such a chance in a fleeting moment... Inconceivable.

spans.text: For you to grasp such a chance in a fleeting moment... Inconceivable.

units.rawText: It was no fleeting moment. When she said that she knew what to do, I knew she'd help us out in the most ridiculous way.
units.displayText: It was no fleeting moment. When she said that she knew what to do, I knew she'd help us out in the most ridiculous way.

spans.text: It was no fleeting moment. When she said that she knew what to do, I knew she'd help us out in the most ridiculous way.

units.rawText: This feeling of deja vu's popped up more than once or twice. The Guardians have always been a place for problem children.
units.displayText: This feeling of deja vu's popped up more than once or twice. The Guardians have always been a place for problem children.

spans.text: This feeling of deja vu's popped up more than once or twice. The Guardians have always been a place for problem children.

units.rawText: Cough cough... At least run first if you knew what I was doing... Look at you lot...
units.displayText: Cough cough... At least run first if you knew what I was doing... Look at you lot...

spans.text: Cough cough... At least run first if you knew what I was doing... Look at you lot...

units.rawText: Arcadia does not abandon its companions.
units.displayText: Arcadia does not abandon its companions.

spans.text: Arcadia does not abandon its companions.

units.rawText: We're still fighting here. Swallow whatever you were going to say next.
units.displayText: We're still fighting here. Swallow whatever you were going to say next.

spans.text: We're still fighting here. Swallow whatever you were going to say next.

units.rawText: We'll settle everything after this darn jellyfish's outta here.
units.displayText: We'll settle everything after this darn jellyfish's outta here.

spans.text: We'll settle everything after this darn jellyfish's outta here.

units.rawText: Ooh~ count me in. Even I'm getting a little angry~
units.displayText: Ooh~ count me in. Even I'm getting a little angry~

spans.text: Ooh~ count me in. Even I'm getting a little angry~

units.rawText: Havoc's companions stand in front of her, extending a hand.
units.displayText: Havoc's companions stand in front of her, extending a hand.

spans.text: Havoc's companions stand in front of her, extending a hand.

units.rawText: You guys...
units.displayText: You guys...

spans.text: You guys...

units.rawText: Get up and help if you can still stand. I'm making Boss cut your vacation otherwise, idiot.
units.displayText: Get up and help if you can still stand. I'm making Boss cut your vacation otherwise, idiot.

spans.text: Get up and help if you can still stand. I'm making Boss cut your vacation otherwise, idiot.

units.rawText: Yeah, yeah...
units.displayText: Yeah, yeah...

spans.text: Yeah, yeah...

units.rawText: Havoc returns to her easygoing, everyday attitude, coming to her feet with the help of Lind's arm, aiming her weapon at the Entropic in front of them once again.
units.displayText: Havoc returns to her easygoing, everyday attitude, coming to her feet with the help of Lind's arm, aiming her weapon at the Entropic in front of them once again.

spans.text: Havoc returns to her easygoing, everyday attitude, coming to her feet with the help of Lind's arm, aiming her weapon at the Entropic in front of them once again.
